Shirtless adult man running a sand path by the sea. 24fps. TWO NOTES: (1) frame is 1920x1012, not 16:9 - there are no baked-in bars, the encoded frame is simply 1.897:1, so a 1080-line timeline needs a ~6.7% vertical upscale or a slight side crop; (2) shortest clip in the haul at 6.88s. Escalated the white board on the pole to full res - it is blank, no text. Holds real detail at native 1:1. No br

Adult man in a blue jacket jogging away down a gravel path. 1920x1080, 23.976fps. I initially suspected an upscale, but that was an artefact of my own 4x nearest-neighbour blowup - a true 1:1 comparison against the known-sharp GYZShwp9Tc shows real gravel and grass detail, so it is a genuine capture. There is a small chevron emblem at the jacket collar and vertical reflective marks on the back; bo

Adult woman jogging toward camera through a modern city plaza. 1920x1080, 25fps. Background (parked cars, street signs, bollards) is thoroughly defocused - I pulled the car row at full res and no licence plate, badge or sign is readable. Best of the athlete group for a hero running shot. Usable end to end.

tired.note: extreme macro of a man's eye and brow as he rubs it, then blinks slowly. Only an eye and a hand are ever in frame - unidentifiable - no text, no branding, 4096x2160 and 32.2s. The strongest exhaustion image in the whole batch. CAVEAT: around the 40% mark (~12.9s) the focus is off during the rub; 15/65/90% are all sharp

man at a desk at night under a warm lamp, pressing the bridge of his nose, then his temple, eyes closed. Verified at full res: the papers, photos and yellow sticky notes pinned to the wall behind are entirely out of focus and nothing on them is readable; no branding anywhere. 3840x2160, 27.64s. Exactly 'one of the least energetic people you will ever meet' - alone, at night, at the machine

tight side-on close-up of a man face-down asleep on his forearms on a desk. Verified at full res at 4 timestamps: the monitor and its sticky notes are entirely out of frame in this angle - nothing readable anywhere. 1920x1080, usable end to end. Same shoot as tired_7581176 and the rejected tired_7581344; this is the clean angle of it

wider version of the same office desk - man collapsed asleep across it, desk phone in the foreground. WINDOW [0.0,4.5] recorded as data and it is NOT optional: from roughly the midpoint the camera has pulled back far enough that a green sticky note on the monitor is in frame, and at full resolution it reads 'Call back / 510-56-2?4? / Elena!' - a stranger's name and phone number. Verified: at 1.48s and 3.95s the monitor front and both notes are out of frame. Cut only inside the window

man in a grey suit alone in a dark open-plan office, loosens his tie, then puts his head down on the desk. Verified at full res: no brand names; the only legible text is handwritten spine numbers (34741, 52867) on two lever-arch files. 4096x2160, 34.32s. RANKED LAST ON WARDROBE AND SET: a suit and tie plus a pinboard of maps and pinned photographs reads as a corporate or detective drama, not a YouTuber who lay in bed all day
man face-down on a bed at night in warm lamplight; nothing legible
in bed at night holding a phone; the phone screen was verified dark and blank with no app UI at native res; beaded bracelet and chain carry no text
same night bedroom setup, lying awake; clean
overhead of a person in bed who disappears under the duvet at about 8.5s; extra sample points confirm no second person enters and no text anywhere
man waking and stretching in a bright white bed; nothing legible

Drained man lying collapsed on a sofa, forearm over his eyes. Plain sofa, plain wall, no props with text. Jewellery is a plain hoop and ring. Clean full length.

Man restless in bed, twin-bell alarm clock sharp in the foreground. This is exactly the 'MADE IN CHINA on a clock dial' failure mode, so I escalated the dial to 3x full res: it carries only the generic word QUARTZ near 5 o'clock - no brand name, no country-of-origin text. Phone on the nightstand is screen-dark. Clean full length.

Man awake in bed, same set as 31414. Escalated the foreground clock dial at 90% (where it is largest and sharpest) to 2.5x full res - numerals only, no maker's mark and no country text. The phone in his hand at 90% is heavily out of focus and edge-on, no legible UI. Clean full length.
Man pulling on a sleep mask and settling down, lights going out. Sleep mask is plain striped fabric with no logo. No screens, no text, no props. Clean full length.

Worried, exhausted man sitting with his head in his hands against a bright window. Plain grey tee with no chest print (checked all 4 frames - contrast this with tired_40251 which I rejected). Blown-out curtain background carries no signage. Clean full length.

Woman tossing, turning and yawning in bed. Warm low-key grade, natively 1920x1080 and not upscaled. No text, screens, logos or printed garments in any of the 4 frames. Second-longest asset at 21.77s. Clean full length.

Overhead of a woman with insomnia turning over. Escalated the patterned wallpaper on the right to 3x because the squiggles read like letterforms at tile size - at full res it is purely abstract doodle line-work with no words. Printed pillowcase is abstract shapes. Clean full length.

training.note: close-up of a hand lifting a hex dumbbell off a rack in a dim gym, yellow wall behind, no face at any of 4 frames. Verified at full res: the only lettering anywhere is a cast weight marking ending '0 LB' on the dumbbell head - a number, not a maker's mark - and the yellow wall carries shapes, not words. 3840x2160, sharp. The only fully clean training clip in this batch

bench press seen from the head end, bar racked and pressed, daylight gym. No legible branding: the curved white lettering on the green plate is out of focus and unreadable at full res, the rest is weight numbering. Other gym users are distant and anonymous. 3840x2160. BLUNT CAVEAT: the lifter is visibly about 70 years old with white hair and his face is central in three of the four frames. That is a different film from a man in his twenties - use tight on the bar and the hands, or not at all

close-up of hands gripping a barbell at hip height, camo tights, dark gym; read at native 1:1 at four marks - no maker's mark on the bar or collars, no text, no faces, background is defocused dark equipment

Close-up of an adult man's arm curling a dumbbell on a bench. 1920x1080, 29.97fps. Escalated the plate face at 65% - it is featureless black, no embossing, no brand. The shorts carry a small abstract blue/green/pink colour graphic clipped at the bottom-left corner; at full res it reads as geometric colour shapes, not a wordmark or recognisable logo. If the owner wants it gone, crop [0.09, 0.0, 0.0

Adult woman on a cable/pec-deck machine, rear view. 1920x1080, 29.97fps. A teal banner with white lettering runs along the very top edge of frame in all four samples. It is cut off and defocused, but it is signage, so I removed it. The crop is verified: I rendered [0.03, 0.06, 0.03, 0.0] at all four timestamps and the banner is gone from every one, with the subject still comfortably framed. Result

Adult man performing a lat pulldown, side view. 1920x1080, 29.97fps. Sharpest of the training group. Escalated two suspects: the lat bar has engraved-looking marks at 40%/65% which resolve at full res as plain knurling, not text; the wall poster behind him is completely out of focus with no legible copy or mark. Background figures are anonymous, unmasked and not performing. Usable end to end.

Adult man bench pressing a loaded barbell, close low angle. 1920x1080, 29.97fps. Escalated the red bumper plate face at 15% - plain painted rubber, no manufacturer name, no weight stamp visible. Bar knurling only. No wall signage in frame. Usable end to end.

Adult woman performing bent-over dumbbell rows past a rack. 1920x1080, 29.97fps. Escalated the printed leggings at 15% and 90% - the print is a panelled geometric pattern with no readable wordmark. Dumbbell face shows only a weight numeral. Background gym-goers are anonymous, unmasked, not performing. Usable end to end.

Adult man working heavy battle ropes, near-total silhouette in a dark gym. 1920x1080, 24fps. Very underexposed - useful as a texture/mood beat rather than a clear demonstration. CROP REQUIRED - do not use uncropped. The crop yields 2930x1648, still well above 1080p and true 16:9. I rendered the cropped frame at 1.5/4.0/6.5/9.0s and looked at all four: no bar
